turns.user: If Daniel died in an accident, what would our booklet pay towards his funeral, and what documents would the insurer want from us?
turns.visible:
The Group Insurance Benefits Booklet (page 9, under “Section 5 - Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit”) prints the Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit for the funeral expenses incurred, up to 2,000 (printed with a bare “$” sign; the Group Insurance Benefits Booklet does not say which currency), with the printed conditions “If an Insured Person dies as a result of an Accident”, “on receipt of proof of death and the relevant documents in our prescribed form” and “This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or the Voluntary Scheme.”.
The booklet does not list the specific documents or confirm Daniel’s enrolment in the Core or Voluntary Scheme, which is required to claim this benefit.
Contact Aldermoor Life Ltd (through the employer or scheme administrator, for this group scheme) about the Scheme X Group Insurance - Certificate to ask what it needs for a claim.

passage.text:
Section 5 - Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit
If an Insured Person dies as a result of an Accident, we will pay the funeral expenses incurred, up to $2,000,
on receipt of proof of death and the relevant documents in our prescribed form.
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or the Voluntary Scheme.

support.text: If an Insured Person dies as a result of an Accident, we will pay the funeral expenses incurred, up to $2,000,

passage.text:
Section 6 - Repatriation
We will pay up to $5,000 for the cost of bringing the Insured Person's body home if death occurs overseas.

(% of Sum Insured)
Neck, Skull or Spine (Full Break)	100%
Hip	75%
Jaw, Pelvis, Leg, Ankle or Knee (Other Fracture)	50%
Cheekbone, Shoulder or Hairline Fracture of Skull or Spine	30%
Arm, Elbow, Wrist or Ribs (Other Fracture)	20%
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or Voluntary Scheme.
F.	Disappearance
If an Insured Person:
(i)	disappears as a result of the sinking or wrecking of the ship, aeroplane or vehicle in which he was travelling at the time of the Accident; and
(ii)	his body is not found within l year from the date of his disappearance; and

Schedule	Compensation
(% of S$5,000)
Neck, Skull or Spine (Full Break)	100%
Hip	75%
Jaw, Pelvis, Leg^, Ankle or Knee	50%
Cheekbone, Shoulder or Hairline Fracture of Skull or Spine	30%
#
Arm , Elbow, Wrist or Ribs	25%
^	For the avoidance of doubt, any fractures of toe and foot are not covered

Section 5 - Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit
If an Insured Person dies as a result of an Accident, we will pay the funeral expenses incurred, up to $2,000,
on receipt of proof of death and the relevant documents in our prescribed form.
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or the Voluntary Scheme.
Section 6 - Repatriation
We will pay up to $5,000 for the cost of bringing the Insured Person's body home if death occurs overseas.
